title: 🎄 Gift Exchange Guidelines
subtitle: Make it meaningful, not mundane!
main_rule: Since you're buying just ONE gift instead of many, make it count! 🎁
avoid_items: Cheap gift cards with low amounts
consider_items: Something related to their hobbies or interests
A quality item they mentioned wanting
A book, game, or tool they'd actually use
budget_note: Quality and thoughtfulness matter more than price!
tips: Check their wish list for specific ideas
Ask mutual friends for subtle hints
Think about what would genuinely make them smile
Include a thoughtful card explaining why you chose it
remember: Remember: The goal is to bring joy, not fill space under a tree! 🎅✨
